technique_name: Write a blog post advocating for teaching students coding skills in school.
description: In today’s ever-evolving world, it is increasingly important for students to be equipped with 21st century skills. One of the most important of these skills is coding, or knowledge of computer programming. The development of coding skills provides learners with an invaluable set of abilities such as problem solving, critical thinking, creative expression, and collaboration. Furthermore, coding offers students a unique and exciting way to understand the digital world, as well as gain vital tools
